senses.gloss: f.(b. h. אַשְׁפֹּת; שפה, שפת , to heap up, cmp.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 1:10:6">Y. Keth. I, 25ᵈ</cite> bot. <cite ref="A02549"><he>אי׳</he></cite>.
Ḥull. 12ᵃ; a. fr.—שער הא׳ (b. h. ש׳ האשפת, ש׳ השפת) Hill Gate, name of a Jerusalem gate.
Ex. R. s. 10 ארבע א׳ four heaps (of dead frogs, = b. h. חמרים); a. fr.—Euphem. מערה לא׳ using means to prevent conception (applied to both man a. woman).
<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 7:5">Keth. VII, 5</cite>. (<cite ref="Ketubot 72a">Ib. 72ᵃ</cite>, acc. to Boraitha, literally, ‘to draw water and pour it out on the dunghill’—as a foolish act).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 85">Gen. R. s. 85</cite>, ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 38:7">Gen. XXXVIII, 7</cite>.—[Homiletic interpretation of <he>בני אשפתו</he>, <cite ref="Lamentations 3:13">Lam. III, 13</cite>, ‘the sons of those laid low’ (conquered); Lam. R. a. l., <cite ref="Esther Rabbah 1">Esth. R. to I, 1</cite>ᵇ, v. <cite ref="A00804"><he>אוֹפִיכָא</he></cite>, <cite ref="A00641"><he>אוּכַּיְיפָא</he></cite>.]
